set.body: Run squared Euclidean, Euclidean, correlation, Pearson, Spearman, and OLS RSA scenarios where semantics match. Acceptance: checked fixtures and JVM/JS scenario courts report explicit max error under named tolerances; nonmatching methods receive a documented non-parity disposition.
